text: A practical, results-driven approach to agentic commerce. 40rty made optimizing our product catalog for agentic commerce simple and actionable. After the initial optimization, we saw a significant increase in agentic sales. Now, an always-on AI agent handles more complex, ongoing optimization directly through Slack. A great tool for brands looking to get ahead of agentic commerce.

Great team and app - they've built a suite of tools that are reminiscent of traditional SEO agencies but for the AI world. We have their agent in our slack making recommendations every day to improve AEO. Highly recommend.

Great team, they listen to feedback and are constantly iterating. The agentic piece is solving for the issue lots of brands are going to struggle with which is bandwidth to address APL updates. I think these guys are getting at something here which is valuable for skating to where the puck is heading for agentic commerce.

I’ve been working on our product listings for SEO for a while, so I was curious about the AI side of things. This makes it easy to see how our products are performing for different prompts and where we need to improve. The interface could be a little simpler, but the data is helpful.

We’ve had a great experience with 40RTY. The platform has helped us better understand and optimize how our products are represented to AI agents, and most importantly, we’ve seen our agent-driven sessions grow since using it. The team is knowledgeable, responsive, and clearly understands where ecommerce is heading. A valuable tool for brands looking to prepare for the shift toward agentic commerce.
Good app for agentic optimization. Great support from the team and Yoav to setup and optimize the app. First sessions and sales are coming in.

The team and support are just great. The product is straight forward and easy to use, great agentic analytics - it makes this whole thing much more clear. They're support on Shopify Catalog and optimization tools are just another level
Exceptional results in no time! Super easy to set up and use, and the results speak for themselves. Highly recommended!

We’ve only been using 40RTY.ai for about week, but the insights have already been really valuable. Easy setup, clear recommendations, and a great way to understand how AI shopping tools see and rank our products. Excited to keep using it.

40RTY has taken the guesswork out of how our store shows up across AI search. We worked through their audit recommendations and saw a real lift in sales coming from LLM referrals. The competitive visibility is genuinely useful too, you can see where you stand against other stores in your category. I've tried other AEO tools and none of them felt actionable for a Shopify store the way this does. UI is clean, easy to navigate, doesn't waste your time. Recommend it for any Shopify store owner thinking about AI search.

40rty.ai was an eye-opener for understanding our product representation in AI search tools like ChatGPT and Gemini. The app analyzed over 600 variants, instantly revealing that hundreds were "poor" for AI optimization. It provides clear, actionable recommendations on metadata and taxonomy to ensure we show up for specific AI-powered searches, such as "locally made luxury jewelry in Kauai". Highly recommended to ensure your brand isn't left out of the AI conversation.

By far the best tool we've found for enabling agentic storefronts. It transformed our messy Shopify tags into clean, structured data that AI assistants like ChatGPT can easily understand making it far more likely our products get discovered and recommended to the right customers. If you're a Shopify store thinking about AEO this is a must-have

This app helped us better understand how to improve our product listings for emerging AI and agent-driven commerce channels. The audit process was straightforward, the recommendations were practical, and it gave our team a useful new perspective on catalog quality and discoverability. Support has been excellent as well.

An app that actually understands GEO. 40rty helped our team at Dear Perli map our catalog for agentic storefronts so we're finally showing up as a top recommendation in Gemini ChatGPT shopping queries.

40rty makes it easy to turn real customer intent into clear action. The intent libraries generate prompts across the entire Shopify catalog and show exactly how to fix product data so it’s ready for agent-driven storefronts.

This app is a one click installation, very straightforward and easy to use, helped us understand how ai agents are searching and selecting products, it helped us optimize using real data and we’ve improved our catalog scoring in weeks, highly recommended!

I've been looking for something to help us out with becoming present on AI queries - not much exists out there for Shopify. Stumbled upon 40RTY on LinkedIn and I must say it's exactly what I was looking for. Scanned my whole catalogue in minutes and provided me with concrete recommendations to improve my product structures, descriptions meta data and more so that I can show for important bottom funnel AI queries. Since I applied the recommendations I'm actually getting AI sales. Highly, highly recommend!

Simple app to run an AI Audit and improve you product/catalogue setup in Shopify for better AI recommendations. Helps you understand the use of tags, images and meta fields and their impact on recommendations from AI perspective. Prompt/Intent and competitor analysis is informative. Looking forward to more features !

Clean and easy to use tool to audit your catalog for getting high quality traffic and recommendations from ChatGPT and others. It goes beyond standard SEO best practices, helping us understand gaps and mess in our product info so we could provide better data than similar stores in our niche.

We installed AgentIQ to optimize our product listings for agentic sales and saw a 20% increase in agentic traffic within the first week. The setup was straightforward and the impact on discoverability was clear almost immediately. For any store serious about staying ahead of how AI agents are reshaping commerce, this is a must-have. If you haven't received one already, expect an email report in your inbox soon that overviews your progress and outlines additional improvement opportunities. As mentioned, please let us know if you need additional support!
Just downloaded this app and I am very impressed with all of the features already. Looking forward to using this

This app is honestly a game changer for staying ahead of how people shop today. Since our products are made of Tyvek and feature very specific artist designs, it was always a challenge to make sure AI agents like ChatGPT or Gemini actually understood the material and the unique aesthetic of the brand. This tool made it incredibly easy to optimize our listings so we actually show up in those conversational searches. It was a breeze to set up and it’s a relief to know that when someone asks for a durable slim wallet with a unique design, our products are being recommended accurately. If you're a founder trying to navigate AEO and want to make sure your brand doesn't get lost in the shuffle, I can't recommend this enough.
